A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same work, Always skip attention, with readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are confined to the first-page author line and arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification experiments, skip-connection ablations, token-graying evaluations, and Jacobian-spectrum analyses, including Tables 2–5 and Appendix C.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Tables 2–5, the skip-connection analyses, and the Jacobian-spectrum experiments in Appendix C.

M1.justification: The SVD and DCT Token Graying procedures, including Algorithms 1–2 and their training objectives, are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, Tiny-ImageNet, and ImageNet-1K with the same supervised classification and self-supervised learning coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical methods and configurations, including the ViT, Swin-S, CaiT-S, PVT V2 b3, and MAE comparators in Tables 2–5.

E3.justification: Model configurations, evaluation metrics, validation sampling, and training settings are identical. Section 6.2 retains the same 400-epoch pretraining and 100-epoch fine-tuning protocols.

E4.justification: The skip-connection removal experiments, amplification-coefficient sensitivity analysis, conditioning plots, and Appendix C Jacobian-spectrum analyses are unchanged.

E5.justification: Neither version reports random seeds, repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and plotted findings are identical. For example, Table 4 retains ViT-B top-1 accuracies of 81.0% without DCTTG and 81.3% with DCTTG; Table 5 retains MAE results of 83.0% and 83.2%.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, assumptions, Propositions 4.1–4.2, their Appendix A proofs, and Appendix B derivations are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about self-attention conditioning, skip connections as regularizers, and Token Graying benefits.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the same conditioning-based interpretations and qualifications, including the unproven proxy assumptions and Section 7 limitations concerning low-precision DCT operations and marginal gains.

D1.justification: Implementation and reproducibility information is identical, including PyTorch/Timm usage, amplification coefficients, model specifications, training hyperparameters, and Table 1 training times.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research positioning, and all 27 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The author name changes from Peyman Moghaddam to Peyman Moghadam, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. All research prose, headings, and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page author line has a slight horizontal spacing adjustment accompanying the name edit, and the margin stamp changes. Figures 1–8, Tables 1–5, captions, and the layouts of pages 2–11 are identical.

improvement.justification: v2 changes an author-name spelling and the version stamp while retaining all scientific content, evidence, limitations, and reproducibility information, including Appendices A–C. These small editorial adjustments do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall quality.
